comparison: Faster and lower VRAM than unified-v11 on DCGAN (47.84 ms idle / 1243.4 MiB vs 87.92-89.19 ms / 1372.6 MiB) and sharper on grid100 & Nash, but regressed 8/16 vs unified-v11 ~15/16 on r4-occam-ablation-v1.
conclusion: law4-energy-v1 achieved 8/16 PASS (7 FAIL, 1 INCOMPLETE timeout on five_word_joint_smoke) on r4-occam-ablation-v1: zero-state Frobenius-MP passed grid100 (center_rms_sigma=0.0765 vs unified-v11 0.1379), zero_tanh_rail_escape, ring16 (hq=0.9861), both Nash >500x tasks (hq=0.9846 / 0.9629 with 0 critic secant probes), and t3_iso_scale_mass_8x (eig=0.5644), and dynamic skew/stiffness-gated 2D NS rescued grid100_mlp16 from 0.0244 to precision=0.9432 (just short of 0.95). However, pure Frobenius-MP under-stepped 4D Conv2d on img_bars4 (2/4 modes) and minor 2D singular directions on model_ddgan_gaussian_chain, vector_unequal_*, and gaussian1d_stability.

decision_outcomes.reuse_note: Compatible original receipts; overlapping readouts are not independent runs or additive costs

hypothesis: law4-energy-v1 matches or exceeds unified-v11 across the 16 surgical probes of r4-occam-ablation-v1 (including grid100_mlp16, model_ddgan_gaussian_chain, t3_iso_scale_mass_8x, zero_tanh_rail_escape, and Nash) while using 0 Conv2d NS and 0 tensor state on non-stiff layers.
next_action: Iterate to law4-energy-v2: keep 0 Conv2d NS with polar-matched 4D scaling, add exact closed-form 1x1/2x2 Cayley-Hamilton Tikhonov polar (0 NS steps) for narrow 2D matrices, and adaptive 3-to-5-step Quintic NS for wide 2D matrices.

study.competing_explanation: If zero-state Frobenius-MP on non-stiff 2D/4D layers or dynamic stiffness/skew-gated 2D Quintic NS loses multimodal accuracy or deep-MLP rank preservation, law4-energy-v1 will fail grid100, grid100_mlp16, model_ddgan_gaussian_chain, or Nash probes.
